title: Patcher output — the aggregated final report
description: One of the run's two outputs; the other is the patched tree. This report describes what the PATCHER DID. It contains no oracle result and no score: scoring happens later, sighted, against the tree. Numbers here are in-sandbox self-measurements and must never be quoted as eval results.

tree_digest_end.description: Digest of the patched tree. Pairs the report with the codebase it describes; a scorer handed a tree whose digest does not match this refuses to run.

cost.description: Measured, from the runtime's own reporting. Never estimated. Report cost even when the run failed — an unreported cost is a cost that gets paid twice.

infrastructure_failures.description: Timeouts, rate limits, unparseable output, crashes. Listed by name so an infrastructure failure is never later read as a reasoning result.

blind_audit.description: Verdict of tools/patcher/src/blind_guard.py. This block is read before any number in this file is believed.

contaminated.description: True disqualifies every number in this report. It means the agent reached, or was handed, material it was supposed to be blind to.

runtime_enforced.description: False means the run used a runtime with no sandbox hook (the fake runner). Such a run exercises the loop and does not measure a patcher; its numbers must never be quoted as a result. Distinct from `contaminated`, which means the boundary existed and was crossed.

dispositions.description: Counts by terminal disposition. Must sum to `tasks`. `fixed` and `fixed_workflow_only` stay separate.

self_verification.description: How well the agent could check its own work. Diagnostics about the ARCHITECTURE, not about the app.

probe_coverage.description: Fraction of tasks whose exploit probe reached PROVEN before the fix. The ceiling on in-sandbox axis-A confidence.

workflow_characterised.description: Fraction of tasks with a green pre-fix workflow test. Below 1.0 means some tasks had no damage detector at all.

rounds_to_green.description: Distribution, not a mean. The mean hides the tail, and the tail is where the cost is.

histogram.description: round -> count. Key `never` counts tasks that never went green.

tasks_net_deletion.description: Candidate fix-by-deletion. Worth reading every one of these by hand before publishing a number.

attestation_calibration.description: Agent claim vs the runner's own measurement, IN SANDBOX ONLY. This is not the sighted False Confidence Rate and must never be presented as one — the sandbox has no oracle. It is the best in-sandbox proxy, and it is a lower bound.

x-publishing-rule.description: Per the root CLAUDE.md publishing rule: `totals` and `run` are aggregate and publishable. `tasks[]` pairs a bug identifier with a file and a line, so it is NOT publishable outside the project. Ship the aggregate; keep the array.
